Script: p = Application.PaletteManager.GetPalette("66570bd8-9070-44a3-91cd-a695987fc88b"); p.Open() docks it; shape.Fill.ApplyUniformFill p.Color(i) or shape.Outline.Color = p.Color(i); get a swatch's index by name with i = p.FindColor("PANTONE 10101 C").

verified.note: Flat muted stand-ins in hue order: silvers/olive-golds, ambers and coppers, roses and pinks, purples, blues, teals, greens, browns and a grey row; mean C* 29.
